articles.title: Two Decades Later, Star Wars Fans Unearth a Wampa-Sized Secret in Battlefront 2
articles.summary: A hidden easter egg in 2005's Star Wars: Battlefront 2 lets you play as a Wampa on Endor. Discovered by modder S1thK3nny, the secret was buried deep in the PC version's code and works in split-screen.

articles.title: A Cannon, a Poem, and Turquoise: The Great Wall's Hidden Lives Revealed
articles.summary: Excavations at the Jiankou section of the Great Wall uncovered a 1632 Ming cannon, a soldier's poetic lament, and 28 turquoise artifacts. The finds illuminate military tech exchange and daily life on the wall.

articles.title: History's Fastest 50 Fly Semi-Final: Kornev's 22.36 Leads Record Avalanche
articles.summary: Egor Kornev clocked 22.36 in the 50m butterfly semis at the European Championships, breaking the meet record. Seven national records fell; it took 22.75 just to make the final, faster than past medal times.
